context.problem_statement: Forecast the next 4 weeks of weekly sales. First detect if there is annual seasonality in the data. Use an appropriate forecasting model. Evaluate forecast accuracy using MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) on a held-out last-4-week window. Report MAPE and the 4-week forecast values.
context.expert_knowledge: Check for seasonality using autocorrelation (ACF). MAPE = mean(|actual - forecast| / actual) * 100. For data with annual seasonality, seasonal naive or exponential smoothing works well. Holdout the last 4 weeks for evaluation before forecasting the next 4.
